shared_rules.graveyard_departure: CreatureCardLeavesYourGraveyard inspects each actual pre-zone creature card, not tokens/emblems, whose owner equals the frozen observer controller. Any destination outside graveyard qualifies. Pre-event observer and additional-trigger witness are reused; queue_zone_trigger_from annotates each original packet; expansion remains only in prepare. Existing CardsLeaveGraveyard batch behavior is preserved.
shared_rules.permanent_keyword_group: GrantPermanentGroupKeywords freezes the deduplicated union of current BattlefieldFilter recipients at resolution, including noncreatures; existing exact-object EOT keyword effects apply afterward.
shared_rules.source_base_stats: SetBaseStatsFromSource samples both signed actual axes once using the current exact source or its pre-departure LKI. Existing opt-in source_quantity_lki captures toughness; existing source_facts supplies power. Noncreature sources supply zero for undefined axes, live or departed. Existing timestamped layer-7b effects preserve modifiers/counters and expire EOT.
